title: Ukrainian Vegan Pilaf
description: A hearty and flavorful vegan pilaf dish inspired by Ukrainian cuisine, made with a variety of grains and vegetables.
instructions: Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add carrots and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add pilaf mix and cook for 1-2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
Add chickpeas, thyme, parsley, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the liquid has been absorbed.
Fluff pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
